The '''Tirahnn system''' was a five-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Zeemacht Cluster/Legends|Zeemacht Cluster]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]].
